jamie-sre: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we identified 4 remediation items that affect SLOs. Need owners + timelines so platform can update dashboards and SLA notes.
alyssa-product: Thanks. Can we list owners here? I can own customer-facing SLA wording and rollout comms.
patrick-oncall: I can take the incident playbook updates and runbook changes. Will need ops steps for auto-fallback.
maria-engplatform: I can own the dashboard panels and alert thresholds. Need the exact metrics we want to track (p95 p99, throughput by model).
ravi-telemetry: I will add event markers for the incident and wire up a comparison query. Suggest adding a recurring regression query too.
jamie-sre: Owners: comms=alyssa, runbook=patrick, dashboard=maria, telemetry=ravi. Two deadlines: remediation sprint end (2 weeks) and SLO proposal for leadership (5 business days). OK?
alyssa-product: 5 business days for SLO proposal works. I'll draft language to propose: lower p95 latency SLO from 300ms to 250ms for hosted tier, add a throughput SLO for heavy-batched endpoints. Will post a PR to the SLA repo.
patrick-oncall: For runbook: adding auto-fallback policy to lower-capacity model after sustained p99 > 1s for 3 minutes. I'll prototype config and include rollback windows. Target: prototype in 5 days.
maria-engplatform: Dashboard plan: add a combined panel with p95/p99 and throughput per model variant, plus an error-budget burn rate gauge. Query I plan to use:
```
select
  model_variant,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99,
  count() as qps
from requests
where env = 'prod' and model in ('rwd-13b','rwd-7b')
group by model_variant
```
I will add a burn-rate alert when burn_rate > 2 for 1h.
ravi-telemetry: Adding incident markers now. Also suggest we schedule a weekly regression job against a short prompt set to detect recurrence. I can add a tracking job to our eval runner.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4218 created: "Remediation sprint - SLO & dashboard updates" assigned to jamie-sre, due 2026-04-08. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-4218
jamie-sre: Nice — I'll split the ticket into sub-tasks for each owner. Please add acceptance criteria: what counts as "done" (dashboard updated, playbook committed, SLA PR merged, telemetry job running).
alyssa-product: I'll add acceptance criteria: doc PR + champions signoff + RFC snippet for customers + comms plan.
patrick-oncall: Runbook acceptance: tested failover in staging, runbook steps documented, and pager triggers validated.
maria-engplatform: Dashboard acceptance: live panels in grafana with correct queries, alert firing tests in staging, link in oncall home dashboard.
ravi-telemetry: I'll attach the nightly regression logs and a sample alert history to the ticket.
jamie-sre: One more thing — recurring pattern note: this is the 3rd latency spike tied to bursty embedding jobs. Suggest a long-term action: rate-limiter per-tenant or dedicated capacity flag. Add to backlog.
alyssa-product: Agreed. Adding backlog item and tagging platform/product. We should propose Dedicated capacity options in next QBR.
patrick-oncall: For now I'll add temporary throttling knobs in the proxy that infra can flip during high-burn periods.
maria-engplatform: Timeline recap: SLO proposal in 5 business days, runbook prototype in 5 days, dashboards merged in 7 days, full remediation sprint complete in 14 days.
jamie-sre: Perfect. I'll update the postmortem with owners, link to ticket, and schedule a 15-min sync in 48h to check progress. @here please add any missing edge cases. :thumbsup:
